page_title: MCI 2-1 AST | Manchester City v Aston Villa 22/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Aston Villa are ruled offside.
90+6' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kevin De Bruyne.
90+4' 2 - 1 Goal! Jeremy Doku tees up Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the left side of the goal. 2:1.

90+3' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
90+2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

90+2' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
90+2' Neat passing move from Manchester City in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

88' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a low shot from long range towards the middle of the net, but Stefan Ortega makes a comfortable save to stop the effort.
87' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
87' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is booked for saying more than Craig Pawson was willing to tolerate.
86' Today's match ends for Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) who will be replaced by Donyell Malen.
85' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Craig Pawson didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
84' A clumsy foul by Axel Disasi (Aston Villa) and Craig Pawson blows his whistle.
83' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is flagged for offside.
80' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) has a goal ruled out for offside!
79' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Stefan Ortega, who smothers the ball.
78' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
77' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
77' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. It's a throw-in for Aston Villa.
76' It's time for a substitution. Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) comes on in place of Amadou Onana.
76' Here is a change. Marcus Rashford is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa).
74' Substitution. James McAtee makes way for Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).

74' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
73' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) tries to find Nico O'Reilly, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
71' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is able to continue to play.
70' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) for a tough tackle.
70' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

68' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
68' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
67' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Good work from Manchester City as they win a corner.
67' A pass into the box finds James McAtee (Manchester City) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Emiliano Martinez denies him.

65' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.

63' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) wastes an opportunity! He unleashed a strong shot from distance after the rebound fell at his feet. It went in the direction of the middle of the target and the goalkeeper pulled off a save to deny him.
61' Matty Cash goes off the pitch and Axel Disasi (Aston Villa) comes on.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and John McGinn (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch so that Jacob Ramsey can be given a rest.

61' What a chance that is! Kevin De Bruyne sends a great ball towards James McAtee (Manchester City), whose shot from the edge of the box flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
60' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
59' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul. Aston Villa are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
59' Aston Villa enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
58' The corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is intercepted by Emiliano Martinez.
57' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Manchester City have a corner.
57' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) will deliver the corner kick.
57' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Manchester City earn a corner.
57' Corner kick. Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is ready to send the ball into the box.
56' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) blows a big chance from close range. His effort flies high and wide of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
55' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) tackles a bit over-zealously and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
54' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
54' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
53' The game is interrupted now, Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings in a cross from the corner, but Emiliano Martinez reads it well and gathers the ball.

52' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
52' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
52' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
51' There's an opportunity for Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
51' James McAtee (Manchester City) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Craig Pawson ignores the protests.
49' Craig Pawson blows his whistle as Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
48' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Nico O'Reilly. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
46' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' James McAtee (Manchester City) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
45+2' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) sends a long ball in, but Emiliano Martinez comfortably gathers the ball.
45+1' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
44' The ball goes behind for a corner. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
44' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa). Corner kick. Aston Villa will have an opportunity.
43' The Aston Villa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
42' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
41' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) jumps into a tackle and Craig Pawson signals a foul.
40' The game is interrupted as Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is flagged offside.

39' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Stefan Ortega leaps like a salmon to deny him.
38' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

37' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
35' A yellow card for a tackle by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa). Craig Pawson doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

34' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.

33' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) attacks the corner from Kevin De Bruyne in the centre of the box, but his header lacks accuracy and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
32' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

32' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
31' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
30' Aston Villa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
29' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
29' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
28' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
27' A pass by Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The linesman signals a throw-in for Manchester City.
27' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Emiliano Martinez.
24' The ratio of the ball possession is 74:26.

23' A brilliant cross into the box finds Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), who directs his low header onto the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
22' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) brings an opponent down and Craig Pawson interrupts the game.
21' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Craig Pawson who sees an offensive foul. A free kick is awarded to Aston Villa.
21' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) sends an accurate pass to Matheus Nunes, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
18' Pep Guardiola (Manchester City) gets a yellow card, off the field.
18' 1 - 1 Goal! Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Stefan Ortega to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
18' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
17' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
16' There's a break in play and referee Craig Pawson must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Aston Villa using VAR. This could be interesting!
16' PENALTY APPEAL by Aston Villa, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
15' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
13' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends a chip pass into the box, but Emiliano Martinez is quickest to intercept the ball.
12' Manchester City are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
11' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will take a throw-in.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
6' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester City.
3' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
3' Manchester City keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
2' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
1' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) received a precise low pass and attempted to surprise the keeper with a quick execution. A superb strike only denied by the right post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Aston Villa will kick-off.
Craig Pawson will officiate today.
